reports.title: The Chefs’ Warehouse Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Guidance
section: We are raising our fiscal 2026 full year financial guidance as follows:
•Net sales in the range of $4.56 billion to $4.61 billion,
•Gross profit to be between $1.130 billion and $1.140 billion and
•Adjusted EBITDA1 to be between $317 million and $321 million.
